entry_timing: confirmed 1H candle close signal, next confirmed 1H bar open reference
episode_definition: false-to-true starts one episode; continuing true remains one episode
volume_unit: BTC base currency quantity for BTC-USDT spot

candidates.hypothesis: A 1H pullback recovery has edge only when the last completed 4H trend is positive.
candidates.economic_rationale: Higher-timeframe demand can make short-term retracements more likely to resume upward.
candidates.entry_rule: completed 4H fast SMA > slow SMA and 1H pullback recovers above its fast SMA
candidates.expected_failure_mode: HTF context only reduces sample size without improving the 1H pullback edge.

candidates.hypothesis: Completed 4H trend direction filters false 1H breakouts.
candidates.economic_rationale: Resistance breaks aligned with broader directional demand may persist more often.
candidates.entry_rule: completed 4H fast SMA > slow SMA and 1H close exceeds the previous N-hour high
candidates.expected_failure_mode: HTF trend lags and removes useful breakouts without improving forward excess.

candidates.hypothesis: Relative base-volume expansion distinguishes genuine 1H breakouts from weak participation.
candidates.economic_rationale: A price break supported by increased BTC turnover may reflect broader participation.
candidates.entry_rule: 1H close exceeds previous N-hour high and current base volume exceeds a prior rolling median multiple
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Volume filtering shrinks the sample but does not improve forward edge.

candidates.hypothesis: Positive 1H momentum has edge when both completed 4H direction and participation expansion agree.
candidates.economic_rationale: Direction, short-term repricing, and participation represent distinct confirming mechanisms.
candidates.entry_rule: completed 4H fast SMA > slow SMA, 1H trailing return positive, and relative base volume expanded
candidates.expected_failure_mode: The combined filters over-condition the sample and create unstable apparent edge.

candidates.hypothesis: Downside displacement mean-reverts only when abnormal volume and confirmed price recovery indicate exhaustion.
candidates.economic_rationale: High participation during a displaced reversal may mark forced selling exhaustion rather than deviation alone.
candidates.entry_rule: close below prior rolling mean, bullish recovery above previous close, and relative base volume expanded
candidates.expected_failure_mode: Abnormal volume accompanies continuation selling rather than exhaustion.
